title: Skelemancer TD
description:
A tower defense game where you command an army of skeleton wizards. Unlock multiple magic skills on each skeleton wizard and switch between them mid-battle. Master fire, ice, lightning, and more to survive increasingly brutal waves of enemies.

Strategically place towers for maximum damage!
Upgrade your wizards and teach them up to 6 skills each! Then swap between each skill mid-battle!Unlock new skills, perfect your strategy, and watch the chaos!
Key Features:• Skill switching system - unlock multiple magic skills per wizard and swap mid-game.

• 27 unique enemies to fight, with different immunities and weaknesses.

• Five handcrafted levels with increasingly difficult waves of enemies.

• Classic tower defense gameplay with a fresh strategic twist.
